notes: Level 7, fill to capacity: 64 plain facts, each on an entity-attribute pair of its own, taught one at a time. Checkpoint phases hold the first k lessons; the model is asked after the first lesson and after every 5th, about the facts taught so far and the controls. Pair phases are fresh copies taught two lessons, A then B. Delete phases take facts out one at a time.
